reason: The free tracker sounds useful, but I need confidence that dates and deadlines are accurate before I spend time applying. Running a server and setting up provider keys is too much friction for me to try another job tool right now.
objection: How do I know the listing date and deadline are current, and will setup take me a whole evening?
would_change_my_mind: A short no-key demo with recently checked listings, visible original links and deadlines, plus a setup path that works on a normal laptop in under 15 minutes.
